bug.name: Bug
bug.description: Defect in shipped behavior — something is broken or wrong. Branch prefix `fix/`. Failing test first; reviewer scrutinizes root cause vs surface symptom.

feature.name: Feature
feature.description: New user-facing capability or enhancement to existing behavior. Branch prefix `feat/`. Standard inner-loop flow with no per-step variations.

hotfix.name: Hotfix
hotfix.description: Compressed inner-loop work for urgent production fixes during active incidents. Branch prefix `hotfix/`. Spawned by mitigation under IC authority; skips refinement; QA may be bypassed.

chore.name: Chore
chore.description: Internal cleanup with no user-visible behavior change: refactors, dependency bumps, lint config. Branch prefix `chore/`. QA may be skipped at reviewer discretion.

spike.name: Spike
spike.description: Time-boxed investigation. Branch prefix `spike/`. Deliverable is a findings doc, not merged code — the PR is never merged. Follow-ups re-enter refinement.

experiment.name: Experiment
experiment.description: Flag-gated feature shipped to a cohort for measurement. Branch prefix `exp/`. Requires hypothesis, metric, and cohort up-front. Post-merge owned by product-owner; closes at verdict on the experimentation lifecycle.

pr.name: Pull Request
pr.description: A proposed code change. Spawned by a developer running `workflow spawn-issue` from inner-loop's implementing state (which invokes `gh pr create`). One ticket can spawn zero, one, or many PRs; the framework owns the spawn relationship.

incident.name: Incident
incident.description: Live production incident. Opened by the IC at declaration; runs through incident-response to stabilization. Mitigation work is spawned as separate `incident-mitigation` tickets. Closes at `stabilized`; the postmortem is a separate spawned ticket.

incident-mitigation.name: Mitigation
incident-mitigation.description: A mitigation work item spawned from an incident. The responder plans in `plan_mitigation`, then `execute_mitigation` dispatches sub-mitigations (hotfix/config-change/data-change) as children. Closes at `mitigated` when all children reach a closing state.

config-change.name: Config Change
config-change.description: A runtime configuration change for an incident mitigation: feature-flag toggle, kill switch, config-value tweak, rate-limit adjustment. No code change, no PR. Closes at `config_applied`, cascading the parent mitigation toward `mitigated`.

data-change.name: Data Change
data-change.description: A data mutation for an incident mitigation: corruption repair, manual update, backfill, event replay. Always preceded by a backup (`creating_backup` → `backup_ready`). Closes at `data_change_applied`, cascading the parent mitigation toward `mitigated`.

postmortem.name: Postmortem
postmortem.description: Post-incident review work. Spawned at `incident.stabilized`; owns the narrative, root-cause integration, and follow-up filing. Distinct ticket from the incident itself so the postmortem can outlive the incident's close.

release.name: Release
release.description: A release-train work item. Tracks one cut through prep → deploy → monitor; experimentation is a phase that operates on the same release ticket.
